Open the MSYS2 terminal and install the necessary packages for building the repository. You will need to install the base-devel package group and additional packages like git and make. You can do this by running the following command: ``` pacman -S base-devel git make ``` 3. Clone the xptmrt repository by running the following command in the MSYS2 terminal: ``` git clone https://github.com/epistelli/xptmrt.git ``` 4. Change into the xptmrt directory: ``` cd xptmrt ``` 5. Compile the repository using the make command: ``` make ``` 6. If the compilation is successful, the compiled binary will be available in the xptmrt directory. You can run it by using the following command: ``` ./xptmrt ``` That's it! You have successfully compiled the xptmrt repository using MSYS2.
